title: The Share of the Opening Period's Allowance a Card Is Owed
content:
The share of the opening benefit period's allowance a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is owed is cut to the months the allowance covers on the tiers that prorate a first load, is nothing on a programme that has closed, and is the whole of the period's allowance otherwise.

**The rule.** The share of that period's allowance the card is owed is that allowance divided by the months in a benefit period and multiplied by the months the allowance covers, where the card's tier cuts a first load to the whole months of the period left and the programme opened after the first day of its opening period; it is nothing, where the programme has closed; and it is the whole of that period's allowance in every other case.

**How the conditions are read.** A tier cuts a first load to the whole months of the period left where its proration basis is the period load reduced to the whole months left in the period; on a tier whose basis gives the whole period load however late in the period the programme opens, it does not. A programme opened after the first day of its opening period is one where at least 1 whole month stands between the first day of the benefit year and the opening day within that period. A programme that has closed is one whose record carries a last day on which the allowance could be spent.

| The card's tier and the programme | The share owed |
|---|---|
| the tier cuts a first load to the whole months of the period left, and the programme opened after the first day of its opening period | that period's allowance divided by the months in a benefit period and multiplied by the months the allowance covers |
| the programme has closed | nothing |
| any other case | the whole of that period's allowance |

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** A period allowance of 135.00 USD on a card whose benefit period runs 3 months, on a tier that cuts a first load, where the programme opened after the first day of its opening period and the allowance covers 2 months: 135.00 USD divided by 3 is 45.00 USD, multiplied by 2 is 90.00 USD. On a tier that gives the whole period load however late the programme opens, the same card is owed the whole 135.00 USD. On a programme that has closed, nothing is owed.
